import MilneLib.Sheaf.InvariantModuleLocalization
import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearModuleEquivalences

/-!
# Localization of equivariant module morphisms

Localizing an equivariant map preserves fixed fractions. The resulting map
commutes with the comparison between localized invariants and invariant
localizations. Equivariant transition isomorphisms therefore localize with
their identity and composition laws intact.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v w w' w''

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R]
  [IsScalarTower K L R] [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R]
  [IsSemilinear K L R]
variable (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]
variable (N : Type w') [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) N] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R N]

local notation "A" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)

variable (b : FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))

/-- Localization of an equivariant map commutes with the numerator action. -/
theorem localizedModuleMap_equivariant (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers b) M) :
    LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (f.restrictScalars A)
        (localizedModuleAction K L R M b g x) =
      localizedModuleAction K L R N b g
        (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (f.restrictScalars A) x) := by
  induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s =>
      simp only [localizedModuleAction_mk, LocalizedModule.map_mk,
        LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, hf]

/-- Restrict the independently localized original map to its fixed fractions. -/
noncomputable def localizedInvariantModuleMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m) :
    localizedInvariantModule K L R M b →ₗ[Localization (Submonoid.powers b)]
      localizedInvariantModule K L R N b :=
  ((LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (f.restrictScalars A)).comp
    (localizedInvariantModule K L R M b).subtype).codRestrict _ (fun x g => by
      change localizedModuleAction K L R N b g
          (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (f.restrictScalars A) x.1) =
        LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (f.restrictScalars A) x.1
      rw [← localizedModuleMap_equivariant K L R M N b f hf, x.2 g])

@[simp]
theorem localizedInvariantModuleMap_coe (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (x : localizedInvariantModule K L R M b) :
    (localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b f hf x :
      LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers b) N) =
      LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (f.restrictScalars A) x.1 := rfl

/-- On a fixed fraction, the localized map applies the original map to its
numerator and leaves its denominator unchanged. -/
@[simp]
theorem localizedInvariantModuleMap_mk (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (m : invariantModule K L R M) (s : Submonoid.powers b) :
    (localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b f hf
      ⟨LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) s,
        mk_mem_localizedInvariantModule K L R M b m s⟩ :
      LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers b) N) = LocalizedModule.mk (f m) s := by
  exact LocalizedModule.map_mk _ _ _ _

/-- Taking invariants and localizing commute on equivariant module maps. -/
theorem invariantLocalizationEquiv_naturality [Finite (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (x : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers b) (invariantModule K L R M)) :
    localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b f hf
        (invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M b x) =
      invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R N b
        (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b)
          (invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf) x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s =>
      simp only [localizedInvariantModuleMap_coe, invariantLocalizationEquiv_mk,
        LocalizedModule.map_mk, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, invariantModuleMap_coe]

@[simp]
theorem localizedInvariantModuleMap_id :
    localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M M b LinearMap.id (fun _ _ => rfl) =
      LinearMap.id := by
  ext x : 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (LinearMap.id (R := A)) x.1 = x.1
  simp only [LocalizedModule.map_id, LinearMap.id_apply]

variable (P : Type w'') [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) P] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R P]

/-- Restriction to fixed fractions preserves composition of localized maps. -/
theorem localizedInvariantModuleMap_comp (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P)
    (hf : ∀ (s : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (s • m) = s • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (s : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (n : N), g (s • n) = s • g n) :
    localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M P b (g.comp f)
        (fun s m => by change g (f (s • m)) = s • g (f m); rw [hf, hg]) =
      (localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R N P b g hg).comp
        (localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b f hf) := by
  ext x : 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) ((g.comp f).restrictScalars A) x.1 =
    LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (g.restrictScalars A)
      (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (f.restrictScalars A) x.1)
  induction x.1 using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s =>
      simp only [LocalizedModule.map_mk, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
        LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- An equivariant transition isomorphism gives an isomorphism on fixed
fractions, using localization of the original map and its inverse. -/
noncomputable def localizedInvariantModuleEquiv (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (he : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), e (g • m) = g • e m) :
    localizedInvariantModule K L R M b ≃ₗ[Localization (Submonoid.powers b)]
      localizedInvariantModule K L R N b := by
  have he' : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (n : N), e.symm (g • n) = g • e.symm n := by
    intro g n
    apply e.injective
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, he, e.apply_symm_apply]
  exact
    { localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b e.toLinearMap he with
      invFun := localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R N M b e.symm.toLinearMap he'
      left_inv := fun x => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b)
            (e.symm.toLinearMap.restrictScalars A)
            (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (e.toLinearMap.restrictScalars A) x.1) =
          x.1
        induction x.1 using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
        | h m s =>
            simp only [LocalizedModule.map_mk, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
              LinearEquiv.coe_coe, e.symm_apply_apply]
      right_inv := fun x => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b) (e.toLinearMap.restrictScalars A)
            (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers b)
              (e.symm.toLinearMap.restrictScalars A) x.1) = x.1
        induction x.1 using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
        | h n s =>
            simp only [LocalizedModule.map_mk, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply,
              LinearEquiv.coe_coe, e.apply_symm_apply] }

@[simp]
theorem localizedInvariantModuleEquiv_apply (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (he : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), e (g • m) = g • e m)
    (x : localizedInvariantModule K L R M b) :
    localizedInvariantModuleEquiv K L R M N b e he x =
      localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b e.toLinearMap he x := rfl

/-- Composition of transition isomorphisms is preserved on fixed fractions. -/
theorem localizedInvariantModuleEquiv_trans (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (d : N ≃ₗ[R] P)
    (he : ∀ (s : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), e (s • m) = s • e m)
    (hd : ∀ (s : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (n : N), d (s • n) = s • d n) :
    localizedInvariantModuleEquiv K L R M P b (e.trans d)
        (fun s m => by change d (e (s • m)) = s • d (e m); rw [he, hd]) =
      (localizedInvariantModuleEquiv K L R M N b e he).trans
        (localizedInvariantModuleEquiv K L R N P b d hd) := by
  ext x : 1
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun
    (localizedInvariantModuleMap_comp K L R M N b P e.toLinearMap d.toLinearMap he hd) x

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
